I have researched the licensing for Motion Canvas (motioncanvas.io). 

**Definitive Answer:**
Yes, Motion Canvas is **100% free for commercial use**. 

**Key Licensing Details:**
1. **MIT License:** The Motion Canvas software itself is fully open-source and released under the MIT License. This grants you the freedom to use, modify, and distribute the software for any purpose.
2. **No Paid Tiers or Enterprise Editions:** Unlike some competitors (such as Remotion, which requires a paid company license for commercial use at scale), Motion Canvas does not have any paid subscriptions, enterprise tiers, or licensing fees. It is completely free.
3. **Full Rights to Your Animations:** The MIT license applies to the underlying tool, not to the animations you create. You retain 100% ownership and full rights to all videos and animations generated using Motion Canvas, and you can monetize them or use them in commercial projects without any restrictions or royalties.

Sources:
- [Motion Canvas Official Site](https://motioncanvas.io/)
- [Motion Canvas GitHub Repository](https://github.com/motion-canvas/motion-canvas) (License: MIT)
